docs/RELEASE_RELIABILITY.md:36:1. **Execution bounds.** Root cause: async middleware performed synchronous SQL and scheduler task creation had no global per-process queue bound or cross-process local collector lock. Impact: blocked requests, duplicate evidence and pool exhaustion. Identity/outcome audit use Starlette's existing thread pool. Local collection owns one dedicated advisory-lock connection, checks due time inside the lock and releases/invalidate-on-error; pending tasks are bounded by configured concurrency and pool headroom. Notification polling runs independently. Kubernetes/boto reads have finite network timeouts. Providers may still need an overall deadline; local locks are not persisted lease/failover acceptance.
